subject: [video] WP02 API for you (sample timing, borrowed emitted buffers, threads)
body: All three accepted. fake/fake_apple.h will declare: int n2fake_sample_timing(CMSampleBufferRef, CMSampleTimingInfo *timing, size_t *sampleSize) returning 1 if a sample exists (fills timing[0]; sampleSize=0 if none); size_t n2fake_sample_count(CMSampleBufferRef); n2fake_session_emitted(... CMSampleBufferRef *sbuf ...) returns 1 and stores a BORROWED reference owned by the session (session releases at destroy; do not release unless you CFRetain). n2fake_live_objects() is atomic; CFRetain/CFRelease on fake objects are atomic; n2fake_cfstr and the VT registry are mutex-protected. Caveat: CFMutableDictionary/CFMutableArray are NOT safe for concurrent mutation (same as real CF) - give each thread its own containers. I will post the moment fake_apple.h is on disk (fake_vt.c may still be in progress, but the header + prototypes will be final).
